chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Jesu in siampi liante leh Pharisee-te' kiangah thugenteh zangin thu gen leuleu hi:
“Vantung kumpigam pen a tapa' ading mopawi a bawlsak kumpipa khat tawh kigenteh thei hi.
Kumpipa in mopawi siim dinga a kikhosa mite a sam dingin a silate sawl a, ahih hangin tua mite hong pai nuamlo uh hi.

Tua ciangin a sila dangte sawl leuleu a, ‘A kikhosa mite' kiangah, "En un, nitak an ka bawl khinzo hi. Ka bawngtalte, ka bawngno kivakthaute kigo khin a, na khempeuh a baihsa-in om khin hi. Mopawi ah hong pai un," ci-in va gen un,’ ci hi.
“Ahih hangin khohsa mite in thudon lo-in paikhiatsan uh a, khatpa a lo ah, khatpa a sumzonna phual ah kuan hi.
A dangte in kumpipa' silate man uh a, bawlsia-in that uh hi.
Kumpipa heh mahmah ahih manin a galkapte sawl a, tua tualthatte susia-in a khuapi uh haltum hi.
Tua ciangin a silate' kiangah, ‘Mopawi an a baihsa-in om a, ahi zongin a kikhosa mite a ne dingin kilawm kituak lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin lamzikpite ah va pai unla mi na muh zahzah uh mopawi ah hong sam un,’ ci hi.
Silate zong lamzikpite ah va pai uh a, mihoih ahi-a mihoihlo ahi zongin a muh khempeuh uh va sam uh hi. Tua ciangin mopawi innpi zong lenglate tawh kidim hi.
“Ahi zongin lenglate en dingin kumpipa hong pai ciangin mopawi puantual a silhlo mi khat mu hi.
Tua mipa' kiangah, ‘Lawm aw, mopawi puantual silh lo pi-in hih takah hong bangci lut theih na hi hiam?’ a cih ciangin tua mipa in dawng theilo hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in mopawi nasemte' kiangah, ‘Hih pa a khut a khe hen unla, a pualam khuamialna lakah paai un. Tua lai-ah kahna leh hagawina om ding hi,’ ci hi.
A hang pen mi tampi a kisapkhiat hangin mi tawmkhat bek kiteel hi.”
Tua ciangin Pharisee-te paikhia-in Jesu ama' kampauna mah tawh a awksak theih nadingun kikum uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin amau' nungzuite leh Herod pawlte kithuahsakin Jesu' kiangah sawl uh a, “Sya aw, a thumaan khat na hihlam leh thumaan thutak tawh kituakin Pasian' lampi a hilh na hihlam kong thei uh hi. Mi' mai en lo na hih manin kua' muhkhialh ding zong na awlmawh kei hi.
Tua hi a, nang' ngaihsutna hong gen dih in. Caesar' tungah siah piak ding phaltheih ahi hiam, hilo hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in amau' thusia geelna thei ahih manin, “No a puatham kineihte aw, bang hangin hong zia-et na hi uh hiam?
Siah piak ding sumtang hong lak dih un,” ci hi. Tua mite in zong denarius tang khat pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, “Hih pen kua' limlemel leh kua' min ahi hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Tua mite in, “Caesar' limlemel leh min hi,” ci uh hi. Jesu in, “Tua ahihleh Caesar' a ahite Caesar pia unla Pasian' a ahite Pasian pia un,” ci hi.
Hih thu a zak uh ciangin tua mite in lamdang sa mahmah uh hi. Tua ciangin Jesu nusia-in paikhia uh hi.
Tua ni mahin (thawhkikna om lo a ci) Sadducee-te Jesu' kiangah hong pai uh a,
“Sya aw, Moses in, ‘Mi khat ta nei lo-in a sih leh a sanggampa in meigongnu tenpihin a sipa' ading suanlekhak neihsak ding hi,’ ci hi.
Tu-in kote lakah unau pasal sagih om ngei hi. A upen in zi nei a, suanlekhak nei lo-in si ahih manin a zi pen a naupa' kiang nusiat hi.
Tua panin a nihna, a thumna leh a sagihna dongin a thu kibang mah piang hi.
Unau teng a sih khit uh ciangin numeinu zong si hi.
Tua ahih manin thawhkikna hun ah tua numei pen pasal sagih lakah a koipen ii zi ahi ding hiam? A hang pen a vekun tua numei tenpih tek uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in tua mite' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: “Note in Pasian' Laibupi ahi-a Pasian' vangliatna ahi zongin theitel lo na hih manun thu na sangkhial uh hi.
A hang pen thawhkikna hun ciangin mite kipi kiteng cih om lo ding a, vantunga om vanmite tawh kibang ding uh hi.
Misite' thawhkikna vai ahihleh note' tunga Pasian' hong gen,
‘Kei pen Abraham' Pasian, Isaac' Pasian, Jacob' Pasian ka hi hi,’ a cih simkha ngeilo na hi uh hiam? Amah pen misite' Pasian hilo-in a nungtate' Pasian ahi hi.”
Hih thu, mihonpi in a zak uh ciangin ama' hilhcianna lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
Ahih hangin Sadducee-te a pau ding uh a theilo-in Jesu in bawl cih thu Pharisee-te in a zak uh ciangin hong kikaikhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin amau teng laka kihel thukhun hilhcian sya khat in Jesu a zia-etna-in thu khat dong a,
“Sya aw, Thukhun laibu sungah thupiakna a koi pen thupipen ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Na lungsim bup, na nunna kha bup, na lungpilna bup tawh Topa na Pasian na it ding hi.
Hih pen thupiakna a thupipen leh a masapen ahi hi.
A nihna zong a masa mah tawh kibang a, na vengte nangmahmah bangin na it ding hi, cih thu hi.
Thukhun Laibu leh Kamsang Laibu khempeuh hih thupiakna nih tungah kinga hi.”
Tu-in Pharisee-te a kikaihkhop laitak Jesu in amaute' kiangah thu khat dong a,
“Note in Khris tawh kisai na bangci ngaihsut uh hiam? Amah kua' ta ahi hiam?” a cih ciangin amaute in, “David' tapa hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in amaute' kiangah hih bangin dong hi: “Tua ahihleh David in Kha tungtawnin amah ‘Topa’ a cih pen a bangci dan ahi hiam?
‘Topa in ka Topa' kiangah, "Ka taklam ah tu in aw, na galte na khe nuai-ah ka koih matengin maw," ci hi.’
Tua hi a, Khris pen David in Topa ci ahihleh ama' tapa hithei ding ahi hiam?”
Tua ciangin kuamah in Jesu dawngkik thei nawnlo a, tua ni-a kipan kuamah in zong thu dong ngam nawnlo hi.
